p: blood: Read Isa 1:15.
pleadeth for truth: All men wink at the injuries and oppressions and none go about to remedy them.
bring forth iniquity: According to their wicked devices, they hurt their neighbours.
eggs of an adder: Whatever comes from them is poison, and brings death.
web: They are profitable to no purpose.
judgment far from us: That is, God's vengeance to punish our enemies.
justice overtake us: God's protection to defend us.
blind: We are altogether destitute of counsel, and can find no end to our miseries.
bears: We express our sorrows by outward signs, some more and some less.
sins testify against us: This confession is general to the Church to obtain remission of sins, and the prophets did not exempt themselves from the same.
falsehood: That is, against our neighbours.
judgment is turned away backward: There is neither justice nor uprightness among men.
a prey: The wicked will destroy him.
therefore his arm brought: Meaning, to do justice, and to remedy the things that were so far out of order.
salvation to him: That is, his Church or his arm helped itself and did not seek aid from any other.
helmet of salvation upon his head: Signifying that God has all means at hand to deliver his Church and to punish their enemies.
isles he will repay recompence: That is, your enemies who dwell in various places, and beyond the sea.
come in like a flood: He shows that there will be great affliction in the Church, but God will always deliver his.
them that turn from transgression in: By which he declares that the true deliverance from sin and Satan belongs to none but to the children of God, whom he justifies.
shall not depart out of thy: Because the doctrine is made profitable by the virtue of the Spirit, he joins the one with the other, and promises to give them both to his Church for ever.
